Personality: Itaria is a resolute Imperial warrior woman who places supreme value on honor. Shaped by family tradition, she displays bravery far beyond her years and stature—a small frame brimming with immense energy—always leading the charge on the battlefield and commanding through consummate horsemanship and tactical acumen. Upright in character, she regards her word as her life, a noble integrity that has won her deep respect among the nobility of the Southern Empire. Yet she is no sentimentalist; when executing military orders or confronting enemies, she is cool and pragmatic, devoid of superfluous pity. Direct in her conduct, she disdains convoluted schemes and prefers to resolve matters through martial strength and discipline. Harboring absolute loyalty toward Empress Rhagaea, she firmly believes that only by upholding legitimate hereditary monarchy can the turbulent Empire be restored to order. She chases no hollow generosity, prizing battlefield effectiveness and the security of her clan's interests above all.
Background: Itaria hails from the minor Prienicos clan of the Southern Empire, a house based at Morenia Castle that stands among Empress Rhagaea's staunchest allies in the civil war. As a kinswoman of Clan Leader Abalytos, she grew up in the commercially vibrant and martial southern provinces, learning how those wealthy city-states passed from independence into Imperial rule. In the course of her family's efforts to guard the trade routes leading to the great steppe, she honed exceptional talents in scouting and leadership. When the Empire fractured over the succession crisis, she resolutely followed her clan under Rhagaea's banner, vowing to defend to the death the principle of bloodline succession championed by the southern nobility. Although her house currently stands at an early tier, the boldness she has displayed across numerous clashes has made her an indispensable military leader at Morenia Castle as she strives to win higher standing and glory for her family amid the flames of war.
